title: PartnerTree Overview Tour
description: Administrative interface for managing organizational hierarchy and partner tree structure. Allows viewing, editing, and organizing partner categories and groups in a hierarchical tree format.

popover.title: Welcome to PartnerTreeComponent
popover.description: This page provides the administrative interface for managing your organization's hierarchical structure. You can view, edit, and organize partner categories and groups in a tree-like format, allowing for clear visualization and management of your business relationships and internal structures.

popover.title: New Partner Level
popover.description:
Opens a dialog to create a new organizational node, such as a category, group, or level, within the partner hierarchy tree.

When to use: When you need to add a new organizational category to the partner tree structure., When you need to add a new group to the partner tree structure.

popover.title: Tour Complete!
popover.description: You've learned the key features of PartnerTree. You can always restart this tour from the help menu.
